error.name: MC_ERR_PARAM
error.text: A parameter is missing or out of range. Velocity, Acceleration and Deceleration must be available either on the FB or on the axis; Acceleration, Deceleration and Jerk must not be negative.

error.name: MC_ERR_STATE
error.text: Not allowed in the axis' current state — the axis is in ErrorStop, Disabled or Homing.

error.name: MC_ERR_NOT_HOMED
error.text: Absolute move on an unreferenced axis with an incremental encoder — home the axis first.

error.name: MC_ERR_QUEUE_FULL
error.text: The command buffer is full (KRON_MOTION_QUEUE_DEPTH entries).

error.name: MC_ERR_STOP_ACTIVE
error.text: MC_Stop holds the axis while its Execute is high; no other motion command is accepted (PLCopen 3.3, note 2).

error.name: MC_ERR_AXIS
error.text: Axis error: drive fault (CiA402 fault bit), lost power stage while enabled, or following error above MaxPositionLag.

error.name: MC_ERR_AXIS
error.text: Axis error; Valid is reset while it stands

block.note: MC_Stop is never buffered and is only refused when the axis is in ErrorStop.
Never buffered; a new one replaces the running superimposed motion.

error.name: MC_ERR_PARAM
error.text: Unknown ParameterNumber (see Table 5 and the vendor range 1000+)

block.note: Reports the state diagram; it has no error of its own.
Reports the axis error in AxisErrorID; an axis error does not make this block invalid.

error.name: MC_ERR_AXIS
error.text: The error could not be cleared — it is still pending in the drive
